question: Does a scale fitted on these base scenarios hold on scenarios it never saw?

grouping.why: seed_family is unique on all 1080 scenarios, so grouping by it would group nothing. Groups are built from three measured link rules; see ipb/splits/grouping.py.

dry_run.note: Drawn from train only, stratified by family. Regenerable: this is a proposal, not a commitment, and phase 2 may pick a different size or over-sample format for checker coverage.

cross_family_confound.note: Excluded from the pure path estimate by their own notes, not from the split. Listed so an analysis cannot forget them.
